description: Get MCP server recommendations. Pass `query` to describe a goal or task (e.g. "file sync with cloud storage", "manage GitHub issues"). Omit `query` to get suggestions based on your recent tool-call patterns.

category.description: Optional category slug to filter (e.g. 'developer-tools', 'data-databases'). Only used with `query`.

query.description: Free-text goal or task. When provided, recommends servers that match this intent using semantic/keyword/expansion search. When omitted, recommends based on usage history.

name: mcp_recommend
